hooks.paths: DIR=$(ls -d ~/.cargo/registry/src/*/unicode-width-0.2.2); grep -ri "unicode" "$DIR/CHANGELOG.md" | head -20; echo "---"; head -20 "$DIR/src/tables.rs" 2>/dev/null; grep -rn "UNICODE_VERSION\|generated" "$DIR/src/"*.rs | head -10
cargo search "general-category" 2>&1 | head -20; echo "---east-asian---"; cargo search "east-asian-width" 2>&1 | head -20; echo "---categories---"; cargo search "unicode-categories" 2>&1 | head -20
cargo info unicode-general-category 2>&1 | head -30; echo "===east-asian-width==="; cargo info east-asian-width 2>&1 | head -30

DIR=$(ls -d ~/.cargo/registry/src/*/east-asian-width-0.1.0 2>/dev/null); cat "$DIR/CHANGELOG.md" | head -40; echo "---enum---"; grep -n "enum DisplayWidth\|Wide\|Fullwidth\|Halfwidth\|Ambiguous\|Neutral\|Narrow" "$DIR/src/lib.rs" | head -40; echo "---unicode version---"; grep -rn "Unicode\|UNICODE_VERSION\|15\.\|16\.\|17\." "$DIR/src/"*.rs | head -20
cargo search "ucd-" 2>&1 | head -20; echo "---"; cargo search "east_asian_width" 2>&1 | head -10; echo "---xi---"; cargo search "unicode-width-east" 2>&1 | head -10
cargo info ucd 2>&1 | head -20; echo "===unic-ucd-age==="; cargo info unic-ucd-age 2>&1 | head -20

curl -sS "https://index.crates.io/un/ic/unicode-width" 2>&1 | tail -20 | python3 -c "
import sys, json
for line in sys.stdin:
    line=line.strip()
    if not line: continue
    d = json.loads(line)
    print(d['vers'], d.get('yanked'))
"

cd $TMPDIR && curl -sS -o uw-0.2.0.crate "https://static.crates.io/crates/unicode-width/unicode-width-0.2.0.crate" -w "HTTP %{http_code} size %{size_download}\n" && tar -xzf uw-0.2.0.crate && grep -n "UNICODE_VERSION" unicode-width-0.2.0/src/tables.rs

cd $TMPDIR && curl -sS -o uw-0.2.1.crate "https://static.crates.io/crates/unicode-width/unicode-width-0.2.1.crate" -w "HTTP %{http_code} size %{size_download}\n" && tar -xzf uw-0.2.1.crate && grep -n "UNICODE_VERSION" unicode-width-0.2.1/src/tables.rs
for c in eaw wcwidth unicode-eaw xi-unicode term-width unicode-linebreak charwidth unicode-char-width str-width; do echo "=== $c ==="; cargo info $c 2>&1 | head -6; done

curl -sS -m 15 "https://registry.npmjs.org/@unicode/unicode-16.0.0" -o "$TMPDIR/pkg.json" -w "HTTP %{http_code} size %{size_download}\n"; python3 -c "
import json
d = json.load(open('$TMPDIR/pkg.json'))
print(list(d.keys())[:20])
print(d.get('description'))
vers = list(d.get('versions', {}).keys())
print(vers[-5:] if vers else 'no versions')
"

python3 -c "
import json
d = json.load(open('$ENV_TMPDIR' if False else __import__('os').environ['TMPDIR']+'/pkg.json'))
print(d.get('description'))
vers = list(d.get('versions', {}).keys())
print('num versions', len(vers))
print(vers[-3:])
latest = d.get('dist-tags',{}).get('latest')
print('latest', latest)
"

python3 -c "
import json, os
d = json.load(open(os.environ['TMPDIR']+'/pkg.json'))
v = d['dist-tags']['latest']
tarball = d['versions'][v]['dist']['tarball']
print(tarball)
"
cd $TMPDIR && mkdir -p unicode16 && tar -xzf unicode-16.tgz -C unicode16 && find unicode16 -iname "*East_Asian*" -o -iname "*east-asian*" | head -30

curl -sS -m 15 "https://registry.npmjs.org/get-east-asian-width" -o "$TMPDIR/geaw.json" -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n"; python3 -c "
import json, os
d = json.load(open(os.environ['TMPDIR']+'/geaw.json'))
print(d.get('description'))
print('latest', d['dist-tags']['latest'])
for v, info in d['versions'].items():
    print(v, info.get('description', ''))
"

python3 -c "
import json, os
d = json.load(open(os.environ['TMPDIR']+'/geaw.json'))
print(d.get('description'))
print('latest', d['dist-tags']['latest'])
for v in d['versions']:
    print(v)
"

python3 -c "
import json, os
d = json.load(open(os.environ['TMPDIR']+'/geaw.json'))
for v in d['versions']:
    print(v, d['versions'][v]['dist']['tarball'])
"
cd $TMPDIR && for v in 1.6.0 1.7.0 1.5.0; do curl -sS -m 30 -o geaw-$v.tgz "https://registry.npmjs.org/get-east-asian-width/-/get-east-asian-width-$v.tgz"; done; ls -la geaw-*.tgz

cd $TMPDIR && for v in 1.5.0 1.6.0 1.7.0; do mkdir -p geaw-$v && tar -xzf geaw-$v.tgz -C geaw-$v; done; find geaw-1.7.0 -type f; echo "---readme 1.7---"; cat geaw-1.7.0/package/readme.md 2>/dev/null | head -40

cd $TMPDIR && for v in 1.5.0 1.6.0 1.7.0; do echo "=== $v ==="; cat geaw-$v/package/package.json | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('version'), d.get('_id',''))"; head -c 300 geaw-$v/package/lookup-data.js; echo; done

python3 -c "
import json, os
d = json.load(open(os.environ['TMPDIR']+'/geaw.json'))
t = d.get('time', {})
for v in d['versions']:
    print(v, t.get(v))
"

cd $TMPDIR && curl -sS -m 20 -o geaw-1.3.0.tgz "https://registry.npmjs.org/get-east-asian-width/-/get-east-asian-width-1.3.0.tgz" && curl -sS -m 20 -o geaw-1.2.0.tgz "https://registry.npmjs.org/get-east-asian-width/-/get-east-asian-width-1.2.0.tgz" && curl -sS -m 20 -o geaw-1.4.0.tgz "https://registry.npmjs.org/get-east-asian-width/-/get-east-asian-width-1.4.0.tgz" && for v in 1.2.0 1.3.0 1.4.0; do mkdir -p geaw-$v && tar -xzf geaw-$v.tgz -C geaw-$v; done && grep -i "unicode" geaw-1.3.0/package/readme.md
cd $TMPDIR/probe && ./target/release/probe && wc -l wide.txt && head -5 wide.txt && tail -5 wide.txt
cd $TMPDIR && for v in 1.2.0 1.3.0 1.4.0 1.5.0 1.6.0 1.7.0; do node dump_$v.mjs > wide_$v.txt 2>err_$v.txt; echo "$v: $(wc -l < wide_$v.txt) lines, err: $(cat err_$v.txt)"; done

cd $TMPDIR && awk '{print $1}' probe/wide.txt | sort > wide_uw.txt
for v in 1.2.0 1.3.0 1.4.0; do
  sort wide_$v.txt > wide_${v}_sorted.txt
  echo "=== $v ==="
  echo "only in unicode-width (missing from $v):"; comm -23 wide_uw.txt wide_${v}_sorted.txt | wc -l
  echo "only in $v (missing from unicode-width):"; comm -13 wide_uw.txt wide_${v}_sorted.txt | wc -l
done

cd $TMPDIR && echo "missing from 1.3.0 (in unicode-width but not 1.3.0):"; comm -23 wide_uw.txt wide_1.3.0_sorted.txt
echo "---"
echo "extra in 1.3.0 (in 1.3.0 but not unicode-width):"; comm -13 wide_uw.txt wide_1.3.0_sorted.txt

cd $TMPDIR && python3 -c "
import json
gc = None
"
# Check general category of the 4 leftover codepoints using our General_Category npm data (Mn = Nonspacing_Mark, Me = Enclosing_Mark)
python3 - <<'PY'
import re, os

def load_ranges(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        content = f.read()
    # find array literal
    m = re.search(r'\[([^\]]*)\]', content)
    nums = [int(x) for x in m.group(1).split(',') if x.strip()]
    ranges = list(zip(nums[0::2], nums[1::2]))
    return ranges

base = os.environ['TMPDIR'] + '/unicode16/package/General_Category'
mn = load_ranges(base + '/Nonspacing_Mark/ranges.js') if os.path.exists(base+'/Nonspacing_Mark/ranges.js') else None
print(os.listdir(base + '/Nonspacing_Mark'))
PY

cd $TMPDIR && python3 - <<'PY'
with open('wide_1.3.0.txt') as f:
    cps = sorted(int(line.strip(), 16) for line in f if line.strip())

ranges = []
start = prev = cps[0]
for cp in cps[1:]:
    if cp == prev + 1:
        prev = cp
        continue
    ranges.append((start, prev))
    start = prev = cp
ranges.append((start, prev))

print("num codepoints:", len(cps))
print("num ranges:", len(ranges))

with open('eaw_ranges.rs.txt', 'w') as out:
    out.write(f"// {len(ranges)} ranges, {len(cps)} code points\n")
    out.write("const EAST_ASIAN_WIDE: &[(u32, u32)] = &[\n")
    for lo, hi in ranges:
        out.write(f"    (0x{lo:X}, 0x{hi:X}),\n")
    out.write("];\n")
PY
wc -l eaw_ranges.rs.txt
head -20 eaw_ranges.rs.txt
